purpose: lane.titlerun real route run (PR #307), by hand under a hold
title: Crimson Skies - High Road to Revenge (USA) (En,Fr,De,Zh,Ko).xiso.iso
route:
# Crimson Skies: High Road to Revenge (4D530021), from perf/run_perf.sh:
# boot 75 s, A x12 at 1.5 s through the intro and the first tutorial
# prompts, settle 12 s. That sequence exposed the crash fixed in fe418afedf
# and is what the Galleon-era perf runs measured against.
#
# The game paces itself to 30. With the sticks centred the plane flies
# level; an A every 20 s dismisses any tutorial prompt that comes up later.
wait 75
mark booted
mash A 12 1.5
wait 12
mark gameplay
repeat forever {
    repeat 6 {
        wait 20
        press A
    }
    shot play
}
